text:
Maria: Hey team — opened PR for KMS/HSM audit hooks that emits export events to the internal audit log. Need security eyes before we merge (target EOD). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8421 :eyes:
Akshay: Can you summarize the main risk vector? e.g., does it add any new IAM perms or change key usage?
Maria: Adds a single read-only export metadata permission (kms:DescribeKeyExport) scoped to the export service role. No key policy changes. Also adds an audit event on key export attempts + structured fields.
Jordan: Is there a migration? Any chance of duplicate events during rollout?
Maria: There's a tiny migration — adds `export_audited` boolean to `audit_shard` table and backfills for last 30 days via script. Backfill is idempotent; we run it in canary first.
Olivia: CI failing on lint in a test file. I'll re-run, but please add a short test for missing fields.
Maria: Fixed lint and added the test. CI passed on my fork. Relevant snippet:
```bash
# run affected tests
pytest tests/integration/test_kms_export.py::test_export_event -q
```
Security-Bot: SCA scan complete — no critical issues found. Dependabot: 0 alerts.
Sanjeev: I can review after Akshay. One ask: can we keep the audit fields stable for future schema? add `schema_version`?
Maria: Good call — added `schema_version: 1` to event payload and noted it in the PR description.
Akshay: I'll take a pass now, aim to approve if no surprises. @SRE-Oncall FYI for deploy timing.
SRE-Oncall: Noted. If this merges before 17:30 we'll slot it into today's midnight release, otherwise defer.
Akshay: LGTM. :thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks all — tagging @sre-oncall and will merge once Sanjeev signs off. :pray:
